sents: You exude an aura of resolve.

sents: When you use Energy Emanation, you can create an emanation of 5 feet, 10 feet, or 15 feet.

sents: Aegis of Arnisant, Body Barrier, Divine Healing, Emissary of Peace, Empyreal Aura, Endure Death's Touch, Guarded Advance (Knight Vigilant), Instant Armor, Instinctual Interception, Interrupt Charge, Keep up the Good Fight, Knight in Shining Armor, Lead the Way, Phalanx Formation (Knight Vigilant), Preternatural Polish, Rallying Charge, Stalwart Standard, Tower Shield Mastery, Unshakable Idealism, Vigil's Walls Rise Anew!, Vigilant Benediction

You are a paragon of all that is good, your overwhelming aura causing evildoers to cower.
You can choose to suppress or resume this aura as an action, which has the concentrate trait.

rows.name: Resilient Touch
sents: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

121
Prerequisites Esoteric Oath
Your aura protects against the twisting powers of aberrations.

rows.name: Magic Finder
sents: You can cast detect magic and read aura as innate spells at will.

When you cast detect magic or read aura from this feat on an item or creature under the effect of a magic aura spell or interact with an item under the effect of an item facade spell, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check to disbelieve the illusion.

rows.name: Invoke the Elements
sents:
**Frequency** once per day

---

You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning.

rows.name: Slip into Shadow
sents: Whenever you cast a spell with the darkness trait, a lingering aura of shadows reduces bright light within a around you to dim light until the end of your turn.
Like in natural dim light, you can use these shadows to Hide, but the aura still makes your overall position obvious, so you can't become undetected through the use of these shadows alone.

rows.name: Innocent Butterfly
sents: You can cast Aura of the Unremarkable once per day as an innate arcane spell.

rows.name: Everdistant Defense
sents: **Trigger** A creature within your aura is targeted by a ranged attack or a creature moves through your aura.
**Requirements** You have at least one aura from a champion feat or feature.
You warp space, causing each square within your aura that the attack or creature would move through to count as triple the distance.

rows.name: Resounding Cascade
sents: You grant the extra damage of Arcane Cascade in an aura affecting all allies in a .

rows.name: Construct Shell
sents: Additionally, if your construct uses an emanation while you're riding on it, such as Explode, you can choose not to be affected by the emanation.

rows.name: Overwatch Dedication
sents: You're surrounded by an overwatch field aura in a 30-foot emanation.
Your overwatch field aura grants you increased perception and allows you to call out warnings to your allies within the aura to point out threats.
This aura has the auditory and visual traits.

rows.name: Consecrated Aura
sents: You gain an aura of vitality energy in a .
Each undead creature that ends its turn in your aura must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).
**Special** Your aura gains the trait of the magical tradition for the spells you used to qualify for Hallowed Necromancer Dedication.

rows.name: Corpse Stench
sents: Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 on a critical failure).
While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition.

rows.name: Enshroud Soul Cage
sents: The magic aura makes your soul cage appear non-magical.

rows.name: Frightful Aura
sents: The aura is a .
An enemy that enters or ends its turn in the aura must attempt a save against the higher of your spell DC or class DC.
**Success** The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to your Frightful Aura for 1 minute.

rows.name: Mummy's Despair
sents: You gain an aura of despair in a lasting 5 rounds.
A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

rows.name: Shepherd of Desolation
sents: If you are a champion, this aura is a champion aura, even though you gained it from Knight Reclaimant instead of a champion feat or feature.

rows.name: Zombie Horde
sents: The horde makes a Strike against each foe within the emanation with a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack rolls.
The miniature companions recombine into a single companion of their original size at any location within the emanation.

rows.name: Dominion Aura
sents: For 1 minute, any creature who ends its turn within the 10-foot emanation takes damage with a basic Fortitude save.
If you aren't drained, you can choose to become Drained 2 when you use Dominion Aura to increase the radius of the emanation from 10 feet to 20 feet.

rows.name: Cleansing Light
sents: All enemies within the emanation are dazzled until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Eldritch Calm
sents: While you are not emotionless, and indeed might be prone to fits of odd moods and tempers, many perceive you as having an aura of unshakable tranquility.

rows.name: Perfect Ki Expert
sents: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: Unblinking Flame Aura for Unblinking Flame, Unbreaking Wave Vapor for Unbreaking Waves, Unfolding Wind Buffet for Unfolding Wind, or Untwisting Iron Roots for Untwisting Iron.

rows.name: Devrin's Cunning Stance
sents:
---

**Critical Success** Your marshal's aura increases to a , and it grants you and your allies a +1 status bonus to skill checks.
When you or an ally in the aura successfully Strike an off-guard enemy, that enemy can't use reactions until the beginning of its next turn.
**Success** As critical success, but your aura's size doesn't increase.

rows.name: Safe Elements
sents: When you Channel Elements or use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura, you can designate a number of creatures up to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 creature).
Choose whether they are immune to the benefits of your kinetic aura or immune to its damage and drawbacks.
You don't have to be able to see a creature to designate it, nor does it need to be in your kinetic aura, but you can't designate a creature that's unnoticed by you.

rows.name: Aura Shaping
sents: You control the size of your kinetic aura.
You can make your kinetic aura's emanation any size from a to a (you must choose a multiple of 5).
You choose the size when you Channel Elements and can change it when you use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Elemental Transformation
sents:
---

You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy.

rows.name: Imperious Aura
sents:
---

Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements.
Use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Air Shroud
sents: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura.
This doesn't displace other matter but provides air for creatures in your kinetic aura that need air to breathe.
Attacks with ranged weapons take a -1 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through your kinetic aura.
Air in your kinetic aura is difficult terrain for flying creatures other than yourself.

rows.name: Clear as Air
sents: If you activate your kinetic aura, the impulse conceals its elements, though any special effects of your aura might give away your location.

rows.name: Ghosts in the Storm
sents: Fast-moving gray clouds surround you, as well as your allies while they're in your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Body of Air
sents: If you activate your kinetic aura, Body of Air ends.

rows.name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury
sents: - Any creature that enters your kinetic aura or ends its turn there takes 2d12 damage.

rows.name: Geologic Attunement
sents: You gain tremorsense (imprecise) in your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Rattle The Earth
sents: This has the effects of Earthquake but comes from you, with an area of a or an emanation with the same size as your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Thermal Nimbus
sents: You and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance equal to your level to damage of that type.
Any creature that starts its turn in your kinetic aura or moves into your aura during its turn takes damage.

rows.name: Crawling Fire
sents: When you use a fire impulse, you can have it originate from the crawling fire instead of you (with the exception of impulses that affect your kinetic aura).

rows.name: Volcanic Escape
sents: **Trigger** An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

rows.name: Kindle Inner Flames
sents: You shed faint, glowing embers, as do your allies while they're in your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Magnetic Field
sents: **Attract** A creature that is wearing metal armor, has the metal trait, or is made of metal treats squares in your kinetic aura as difficult terrain when moving away from you.
You pull unattended metal objects of light Bulk or less in your kinetic aura to you.
**Repel** A creature that is wearing metal armor, has the metal trait, or is made of metal treats squares in your kinetic aura as difficult terrain when moving closer to you.
You push unattended metal objects of light Bulk or less in your kinetic aura away.
They stop moving once they're outside your aura.

rows.name: Shattershields
sents: You and allies in your kinetic aura gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

rows.name: Winter Sleet
sents: Surfaces in your kinetic aura are coated in slippery ice.

rows.name: Sea Glass Guardians
sents: They attempt to intercept all dangers, granting you and your allies within your kinetic aura a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws.

rows.name: Fresh Produce
sents: Choose a creature in your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Ravel of Thorns
sents: Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura.

rows.name: Drifting Pollen
sents: A creature in your kinetic aura when you enter the stance, or who later enters the aura or ends its turn in the aura, attempts at a save against your class DC.

rows.name: Orchard's Endurance
sents: You and your allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing damage.

rows.name: Turn the Wheel of Seasons
sents: **Winter** Each enemy in the aura takes damage with a save against your class DC.

rows.name: Desert Wind
sents: Each creature inside your kinetic aura (including you) is concealed from any creature outside your kinetic aura, and creatures outside the aura are concealed from creatures inside the aura other than you.
When you use a damaging air impulse that affects at least one creature in your kinetic aura, that impulse deals 1 additional slashing damage, or 2 if the impulse has a single target.

rows.name: Steam Knight
sents: You shape your kinetic aura into swirling armor of steam that scalds your enemies and propels you on super-heated jet streams.
It deals damage to each creature in your kinetic aura with a save against your class DC.

rows.name: Kineticist Dedication
sents: You gain a kinetic aura and the Channel Elements action, though you don't get to use an Elemental Blast or stance impulse when you take that action.

rows.name: Directed Audience
sents: Whenever you cast a composition spell whose area is an emanation, you can change the spell's area to a cone 10 feet larger, to a maximum of twice the original area.

rows.name: Combat Reading
sents: You use a performer's cold reading techniques, aura reading, and other tricks to discover your foe's strengths and weaknesses.

rows.name: In Tune
sents: If your next action is casting a composition spell with an emanation area, its area spreads from a willing ally of your choice within 60 feet instead of you.

rows.name: Impressive Landing
sents: Any creature in the emanation when you land takes damage as the debris hits it and is off-guard until the start of its next turn.

rows.name: Nimble Reprisal
sents: The enemy needs to be in range, but not in reach, and it must still be in your champion's aura.

rows.name: Divine Health
sents: Allies in your champion's aura get this benefit, but their bonus is +1.

rows.name: Aura of Courage
sents: At the end of your turn, each ally in your champion's aura reduces its frightened value by 1.

rows.name: Aura of Despair
sents: Enemies in your champion's aura take a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against fear.
In addition, an enemy that ends its turn in your champion's aura can't reduce the value of its frightened condition below 1.

rows.name: Security
sents: If you do, you can choose one ally in your champion's aura to gain a spirit shield that accompanies it.
For 1 minute, that ally gains the benefits of *shields of the spirit*, even while the ally isn't in your champion's aura and even if your shield isn't raised.

rows.name: Expand Aura
sents: Expand the radius of your champion's aura to 30 feet until the start of your next turn.

rows.name: Aura of Faith
sents: You radiate an aura of belief that imbues your attacks and those of nearby allies with divine power.
Each willing ally in your champion's aura adds the holy trait to their Strikes if you're holy or adds the unholy trait to their Strikes if you're unholy.

rows.name: Aura of Determination
sents: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body.
You and all allies in your champion's aura gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental, morph, and polymorph effects.

rows.name: Aura of Life
sents: Your aura protects against the power of the Void.
You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to void damage and a +1 status bonus to saves against void effects.

rows.name: Aura of Righteousness
sents: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you.
You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to unholy spells, unholy Strikes, and other unholy effects.
If a teleportation spell or effect would teleport an unholy creature out of your champion's aura, your aura attempts to counteract it, using the spell rank and DC of your devotion spells.

rows.name: Swift Paragon
sents: If your ally starts a move action in your champion's aura, their movement during that action doesn't trigger reactions.

rows.name: Trial by Skyfire
sents: A rain of blazing bolts begins to fall from the heavens in a , centered on you, that deals damage to all creatures in the emanation at the end of each of your turns ( save); you can't exclude yourself from the emanation.
If you become Cursebound 3 or 4 at any point during Trial by Skyfire's duration, the emanation increases to 15 feet and the damage increases to .

rows.name: Champion Dedication
sents: You are bound by your deity's anathema and gain the champion's aura and sanctification as described in the champion class.

rows.name: Magical Scholastics
sents: You can cast Detect Magic, Guidance, and Read Aura as occult innate cantrips.

rows.name: Command Attention
sents: When an enemy within the aura attempts to use a visual effect that involves focusing its attention on a particular creature (such as a medusa's Focus Gaze), it must succeed at a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, in order to target any creature except you.
Allies in the aura can attempt to Hide even if they don't have cover, as you are continually providing a distraction.

rows.name: Marshal Dedication
sents: In addition, you're surrounded by a marshal's aura in a .
Your aura has the emotion, mental, and visual traits and grants you and allies within the aura a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

rows.name: Dread Marshal Stance
sents:
---

**Success** Your marshal's aura grants you and your allies in the aura a +1 status bonus to damage rolls.
When you or an ally in the aura critically hit an enemy with a Strike, that enemy is Frightened 1.

rows.name: Inspiring Marshal Stance
sents:
---

**Success** Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

rows.name: Snap Out of It!
sents: Choose one target ally in your marshal’s aura who is affected by a mental effect that allowed a Will save and has a duration of no longer than 1 minute.

rows.name: Steel Yourself!
sents: Choose one ally in your marshal's aura.

rows.name: Cadence Call
sents: Each willing ally in your marshal's aura is quickened until the end of their next turn, and they can use the extra action only to Stride.

rows.name: To Battle!
sents: Choose one ally in your marshal's aura who has a reaction available.

rows.name: Hidden Magic
sents: A spellcaster using Detect Magic or Read Aura must succeed at a Perception check against your Deception DC to see through your obfuscations.

rows.name: Convocation of Earth and Moon
sents: If you have your head gem, it radiates an aura of moonlight, causing creatures that start their turn adjacent to you to become dazzled until the beginning of their turn unless they succeed at a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

rows.name: Strategist Stance
sents:
---

**Critical Success** Your marshal's aura increases to a , and it grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to Reflex saving throws.

Once per turn, when you succeed or critically succeed at a Recall Knowledge check to gain information about an enemy creature, the target of the Recall Knowledge check becomes off-guard to the next attack made against it by you or an ally in your aura.
**Success** As critical success, but your aura's size doesn't increase.

rows.name: Know Your Enemy
sents: Any ally within your aura who's trained in the skill you use to attempt the Recall Knowledge check can use their reaction to Aid you on the check without having prepared to help first.

rows.name: Form Up!
sents: Allies within your aura can use their reaction to Stride up to their Speed and take a place in the chosen formation.
- **Cluster** Your allies gather into any space that would be covered by a in an aura around you.

rows.name: General's Gambit
sents: On a success, in addition to the normal outcome for Creating a Diversion, the enemy becomes fascinated with you until the start of your next turn and can't use reactions against allies in your aura.

rows.name: Pushing Wind
sents: So long as you're holding a fan, you and allies who start their turn in a 30- foot aura emanating around you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to land Speed for 1 round; you also gain this bonus to your fly Speed if you possess one, but it can't grant you the ability to fly if you wouldn't otherwise be able to.
While holding a fan, the area in a 10-foot aura emanating around you is difficult terrain for all enemies.

rows.name: World-breaking Footfall
sents: All other creatures within the emanation take damage with a save against your class DC.

rows.name: Spiritual Expansion Spell
sents: You can also use this feat to increase the radius of an emanation spell with a duration by 5 feet by dedicating your primary apparition to maintaining the spellshape; dedicating the apparition to the spell prevents you from using the apparition's vessel spell, apparition skills, or Avatar form for the duration of the modified spell.

rows.name: Spirit Walk
sents: During your first turn in an encounter, you and allies in the aura have resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt by haunts or spirits.

rows.name: Rejoice in Solstice Storm
sents: The emanation is quartered into four non-overlapping cones, each of a different season, which must be arranged clockwise from spring, to summer, to fall, to winter.

rows.name: Seneschal Witch Dedication
sents: When you cast or Sustain manifest will, as long as your charge is within 30 feet, you can choose to center the spell's emanation on your charge instead of yourself.

rows.name: Shining Glory
sents:
---

With a righteous word, your divine aura inspires your allies to great heroics and causes foes to tremble.

rows.name: Divine Invulnerability
sents: You gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level for 1 minute as your aura smolders with power.

rows.name: My Kingdom, My Blood
sents: You then plant your fist or weapon into the ground at your feet, creating a in an aura around you that lasts for 1 minute.
Whenever an ally within this aura takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half the damage in their stead while they take the remainder.
Whenever you take damage while this effect is active, an ally within the aura can use their reaction to take half the damage for you in the same manner.

rows.name: Extend Surge
sents: **Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.
Until the start of your next turn, the radius of your *spellsurge* aura increases to 30 feet.

rows.name: Invigorating Surge
sents: **Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.

---

You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally.
You grant one creature within your *spellsurge* aura temporary Hit Points equal to your level.
These temporary Hit Points last for as long as the target is in the aura.
If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you grant the temporary Hit Points to a number of creatures up to half your level that are within the aura.

rows.name: Spell Network
sents:
---

Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands.

While you're in this stance, an ally within your *spellsurge* aura can treat any other ally within the aura as the point of origin for a spell they cast, calculating range and cover from the other creature's space instead of their own.
This allows all allied creatures within your *spellsurge* aura to act as though they're in touch range of each other since each creature is in touch range of itself.
Additionally, while you're in this stance, an ally casting a spell that targets only the caster can have that spell affect any other ally within your *spellsurge* aura instead.

rows.name: Burning Surge
sents: **Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell within your Spellsurge aura.

rows.name: Imbue Spell
sents: Upon completing the Casting of a Spell, instead of the normal effects of the spell, you imbue the energy of that spell to an ally that's adjacent to you or within your Spellsurge aura.

rows.name: Mystical Flare
sents: **Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.
All creatures within your *spellsurge* aura become concealed, and all creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it.

rows.name: Rapid Switch
sents:
**Frequency** once per round

**Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.

---

You've honed your control over your *spellsurge* aura and can rapidly alter its effects.
Sustain *spellsurge* to choose a different effect for its aura.

rows.name: Recharging Transference
sents: Expend one prepared spell, spell slot, or Focus Point, and choose an adjacent ally or an ally within your Spellsurge aura.

rows.name: Thundering Surge
sents: **Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.

rows.name: Galvanize Spell
sents:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** Your Spellsurge aura is active.

---

You reabsorb the magic of your *spellsurge* aura to power a piece of powerful magic.

rows.name: Mythic Counter
sents: If the target of the counteract check is within your Spellsurge aura, critical failures on this check are treated as failures.

rows.name: Mystic Life Force
sents: You can't die except due to old age as long as you're under the effects of an ongoing spell or within your Spellsurge aura; if your dying or doomed condition would increase to a high enough value to kill you, it doesn't increase, and any effect that would instantly kill you instead just reduces you to 0 Hit Points.

rows.name: Surging Interference
sents: **Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell within your Spellsurge aura.

rows.name: Tandem Onslaught
sents: The first time each round that you successfully hit and deal damage to an enemy creature with a Strike using a weapon or unarmed attack, you can automatically Sustain a single battle aura that you currently have active, applying any additional effects that come with Sustaining the spell.

rows.name: Exigent Aura
sents: Your battle auras can affect mindless creatures, though they gain a +4 circumstance bonus on saving throws to resist the battle aura's effects.

rows.name: Empowered Onslaught
sents:
**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** You critically hit and Sustain a battle aura.
Choose one active battle aura you have; that battle aura's status bonus or penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.
This value remains for the rest of the aura's duration.

rows.name: Tandem Auras
sents: When you Sustain a battle aura, you can also Sustain a different battle aura you have active.

rows.name: Live the Creed
sents: You cast a battle aura using one of your divine font slots.

rows.name: Oath of The Defender
sents: Allies in your champion's aura, not including you, get resistance 2 to damage dealt by creatures with the chosen trait.

rows.name: Exalted Greatness
sents: **Desecration** While you have the benefit, you also gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against effects created by enemies in your champion's aura.

rows.name: Healing Sanctuary
sents: An ally who begins their turn in your Shield the Faithful aura gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

rows.name: Divine Presence
sents: As long as you are in this stance, you have a 5-foot emanation that has the aura trait.
Whenever you take an action, you can take it from your space or any space within the emanation as if it were the space you occupy.
An enemy that ends its turn completely within the emanation is off-guard to your Strikes.
You can Sustain the emanation to increase its radius by 5 feet, up to a maximum of 15 feet.

rows.name: The Thousand Lashes of the Weeping Willow
sents: The tree whips its branches at all your enemies within a 30-foot-radius emanation centered on the willow's trunk, dealing damage with a save against your class DC.

rows.name: Irradiate
sents: You exude an aura of radiation, making everyone around you ill.
**Awakening** You become more efficient at exuding this aura of radiation.
The radius of the emanation becomes 60 feet.

rows.name: Prophet of Kalistrade Dedication
sents: You gain a spell repertoire with two common occult cantrips, plus either or Read Aura.

rows.name: Plant Banner
sents: While your banner is planted, any effects that normally happen in an emanation around your banner instead happen in a burst that is 10 feet larger (so a becomes a ).

rows.name: Battle-Tested Companion
sents: While your banner is affixed to this companion, the banner's aura is 10 feet greater than it normally is (typically this means the banner's 30-foot aura becomes a 40-foot aura).

rows.name: Defiant Banner
sents: You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner when you use this action gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn.

rows.name: Rallying Banner
sents: You restore Hit Points to each ally within the aura of your commander's banner.

rows.name: Quickening Banner
sents: Each ally within the aura of your commander's banner is quickened for 1 round and can use this extra action to Strike or Stride.

rows.name: Confusing Commands
sents: Each enemy within the aura of your commander's banner must succeed at a save against your class DC or become confused for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

rows.name: Peerless Mascot Companion
sents: - It gains a 30-foot aura that grants the same benefits as your banner, effectively acting as a second banner.
If you have your actual banner affixed to your companion, the aura is a single 60-foot aura (this includes the increased aura benefit from Battle-Tested Companion).
If you later gain the Glorious Banner feat, your banner has a 100-foot aura while it is affixed to your peerless mascot companion.

rows.name: Glorious Banner
sents: Enemies within the aura of your commander's banner take a –2 status penalty to Will saves as long as they can see your banner.

rows.name: Pennant of Victory
sents: You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner gain a +4 status bonus to attack and damage rolls, a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, and 40 temporary Hit Points.

rows.name: Commander Dedication
sents: You gain a commander's banner that grants you a 30-foot aura for the purposes of using your tactics, but the banner does not grant the commander's banner bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects.

rows.name: Topple the Titans
sents: Apply the result of your triggering Athletics check against the Reflex DC of each creature in the emanation to Trip them as well.

rows.name: Kinetic Dampening
sents: You can choose which creatures within the emanation are affected.

rows.name: Tectonic Stomp
sents: You raise up to three stone chunks from the ground in unoccupied squares in the emanation; the stones can't be adjacent to one another.

rows.name: Form a Flock
sents: As long as you're surrounded by your flock, you gain weakness 5 to area and splash damage and have a flock aura in a .
Enemies in this aura are dazzled.

rows.name: Frightening Power
sents: If you are Channeling Draconic Essence, your spectral dragon can be the origin of this emanation.

rows.name: War Rider Stance
sents: While in this stance, your dragon companion has an aura in a .
Each creature that starts its turn in the aura takes the damage listed under the dragon's support benefit with a basic Reflex save against your mount's Athletics DC.

rows.name: Strafing Breath
sents: The aura from War Rider Stance increases to a during this movement, and each creature that's in the emanation at any point during your movement takes the damage from it (with the normal save).

rows.name: Oatia Skysage Dedication
sents: You gain a spell repertoire with two of the following cantrips of your choice: Detect Magic, Guidance, Know the Way, or Read Aura.

rows.name: Preserve the Moment
sents: For example, if you Stride up to a firewyrm, roll a basic Reflex save against its intense heat aura, then Strike the firewyrm with a longsword, and then Climb up an adjacent wall, when you activate Preserve the Moment you record only the Stride action, the Strike action (and the die roll result you roll for the Strike), and the Climb action (and the die roll result you roll for the Athletics check to do so); you do not record your Reflex save against the aura's effects.

rows.name: Dark Persona's Presence
